description: Found while fixing bedrock-mi1 (PR #258). test/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/key_selector_property_test.exs has '_ -> true' catch-alls on four of five properties, so the resolution bugs #258 fixed (last_less_or_equal returning the predecessor, first_greater_than skipping a key, backward cross-page resolution returning :not_found) never failed a property. Replace the catch-alls with the differential model the #258 auditor used: resolve every selector against a flat sorted key list via FoundationDB's KeySelectorRef semantics and assert the index returns the same key across page boundaries and at both ends. Also delete the dead zero_offset?/positive_offset?/negative_offset? KeySelector API (no callers, no FDB analogue) while in the file.
title: key_selector_property_test.exs never guards selector semantics: four of five properties end in a '_ -> true' catch-all
